instructions_to_main_agent: Build Framewright as a fully featured frontend React + Tailwind app matching Linear/Vercel/Raycast design system. Ensure all interactive elements have data-testid attributes, support mock generation pipeline across 13 stages with stage inspector, confidence counter, live responsive preview, side code editor, history, and theme toggle.
universal_guidelines: Never use pure black #000000; use #07080A with surface ladder.
All interactive elements must include data-testid.
Do not use transparent headers without backdrop blur.
Provide smooth fake async flows with realistic 13-stage pipeline telemetry.
